name: @sunreye/pv-wasm
description: SunReye's PV engine, the pv crate's browser build, and its typed loader (ADRs 17, 25).

scripts.wasm: cargo build --locked --release -p sunreye-pv-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sunreye_pv_wasm.wasm dist/pv.wasm
